generated_texts: What are the ways to identify a Mastercard ATM?
A duplicate transaction appears on my account.
I've forgotten the passcode for the mobile banking app.
I'd like to correct a mistake I made with a recent transaction. Could you please reverse the transfer? I need it resolved by tomorrow.
I'm having trouble accessing my funds and making a cash withdrawal. Can you assist me?

I'm unhappy about the unexpected charges deducted from my account. I was assisting friends with their relocation to Japan and we made some purchases at local stores. The receipts didn't match the amounts reflected in my bank statement. Can you tell me when I can expect the extra fees to be credited back to my account?
I think the exchange rate used for my card payment was incorrect and I was overcharged
The funds I attempted to add are not showing up on my card.
I'm having trouble remembering my passcode to access the app.
Can you help me avoid the payment fee that was charged on my card?
can you provide the tracking number for my card?
Why was my payment reversed and credited back to my card?
Is my credit card not functioning properly?
How do I go about closing this account?

I recently discovered that the payment didn't process as expected. Initially, the funds were debited from my account, but they've since been reversed. Could you assist me in resolving this issue promptly?
I've changed my mind about the transfer I initiated yesterday. Could you please cancel it and correct the mistake? I'd appreciate it if you could take care of it by tomorrow.
We want to ensure the origin of your funds is legitimate and secure.
I've changed my mind about the transfer I initiated yesterday. Could you please cancel it and correct the mistake? I'd appreciate it if you could take care of it by tomorrow.
I'm having trouble converting this to cryptocurrency, but the app is not allowing me to proceed. Can you assist me with this issue?
What should I do about my jammed ATM card?
What should I do if the ATM swallows my card?
I'm unable to locate the transfer receipt.
I need help resolving an issue with an ATM withdrawal. The app indicates the correct amount I should have received, but I only got a different amount.
The cash transfer I initiated hasn't been reflected on the recipient's end.
I'm having trouble accessing my account because I've forgotten my passcode.
My top-up reversal was processed and I would like to confirm if I still need to complete the 3D Secure authentication process before resubmitting the request.
I've received a new email address.
Did my card payment get reversed?
How do you receive your physical credit cards?
How come I've been charged for the same transaction twice?
I accidentally locked my card due to a mistake :(( Assist me!
Why haven't my card payment cleared yet?

I attempted to withdraw cash earlier, but the ATM appears to be malfunctioning. Upon checking, I noticed that the transaction is still pending. Can you investigate this issue and ensure I'm not charged for the funds I haven't received?
Can I have this card about to expire sent to China?
I'm having trouble topping up my card, and it's consistently being declined. I urgently need help resolving this issue as soon as possible.
If I notice a transaction appears on my account statement twice, what steps can I take to resolve the issue?
What steps can I take to prevent unauthorized transactions on my account?
source_texts: How do I know it is a Mastercard ATM?
There is a transaction showing up several times.
I don't know the code for the app.
Hi , I just came to know I made the wrong transaction  yesterday. Would  you please make it correct?I need it by tomorrow.
I'm trying to take money from my account but its not letting me. Help!

I don't appreciate the extra fees being siphoned from my account. I was helping some friends move to Japan and we were buying home decorations at the local stores. The  receipts differed greatly from what showed up in my bank account and my statement. When can I expect the extra fees to be back in my account?
I believe you charged me too much to exchange my money
My money I added isn't on my card.
Please help me.  I don't know my code to get into the app.
Is there a  way to  get around fees
can you share card tracking number?
Why has my money been returned back to my card.
Is my card frozen?
What are the steps to finishing up with this account?
I just found out from the seller that my money didn't go through. I checked my account and it was deducted at first but now it's back in my account. Can you  please fix this for me quickly?
I just realized I made the wrong transaction  yesterday. Would  you please make it correct?I need it by tomorrow.
What kind of security protects my money?
I just realized I made the wrong transaction yesterday. Would  you please make it correct?I need it by tomorrow Please.
